name: Leopard-print cat-eye nail art tutorials
what_it_is: Short-form nail videos showing leopard/cheetah-print manicures, often combined with cat-eye gel polish, in tutorial and finished-manicure showcase formats. Creators demonstrate stamping plates, hand-painted spots, and matte or chrome finishes on almond, coffin, and stiletto nails, with several clips framed as a viral fall 2026 nail trend.
